assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and irregular heart rhythm consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0).
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73).
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to detect asymptomatic arrhythmias and optimize anticoagulation management.
This service directly supports the clinical indication that mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is medically necessary to monitor the arrhythmia and guide anticoagulation decisions.
